summary: Publishes CHOP audio as a network stream using RTSP or WebRTC modes, with port, stream-name, and WebRTC track controls.
key_concepts: Audio Stream Out CHOP streams CHOP audio out to RTSP clients or a WebRTC peer.
RTSP receivers need a URL composed from the sender IP address, Port, and Stream Name.
Mode selects whether the output is RTSP or WebRTC.
WebRTC output uses a WebRTC DAT, WebRTC Connection, and WebRTC Track to identify the peer-to-peer route.
The operator should be activated only after the input audio and network receiver details are stable.

key_params.name: webrtc
key_params.note: WebRTC DAT when publishing via WebRTC

common_gotchas: RTSP receivers need the matching IP address, port, and stream name.
Only enable Active once the intended input audio and routing are stable.
WebRTC publishing requires coordinated connection, peer, and track names with the receiver.
Network streaming introduces latency and firewall/port considerations distinct from local Audio Device Out.
